Everything you need

Self-service, cloud configuration (DDM/CSP), remote lock and wipe, zero-touch provisioning, and platform SSO with support for any identity provider, including Okta and Entra.

Nothing you don’t

No waiting days to patch or hours to test a change. No duplicative work in different tools. No Microsoft E3/E5 bundle required. No black box: ask your AI exactly how Fleet works.

You don’t need the Microsoft bundle

If you’re not 100% Microsoft, you should probably get Fleet. You could save your organization lots of time and money.

Do it once

Fleet gives you Apple depth without the Apple-only tool, so you can standardize how you manage devices without giving up native features like Platform SSO, ADE, and DDM.

Pay for it once

Keep the identity, security, and hardware vendors you chose. The E3/E5 bundle stops being mandatory, because Fleet’s zero touch setup removes the need for Autopilot.

Head of Developer Infrastructure & Corporate Technology

“With Fleet, I just post something in our joint Slack channel and within minutes I will get a reply and we can have a proper conversation. Their support is huge — it's a big selling point for us.”

“Context is king for device data, and Fleet provides a way to surface that information to our other teams and partners.” See the video.

“I’m a huge fan of Fleet and their approach to GitOps.”

CPE manager

“Having the freedom to take full advantage of the product is one of the reasons why I always support open-source products with a commercially-backed company, like Fleet.”

CISO of Lyft

“I love the steady and consistent delivery of features that help teams work how they want to work, not how your product dictates they work.”

Dan Grzelak

Security Chief of Staff

“This is not just production osquery, but actually a way bigger opportunity than even something like Airwatch or Jamf.”

Eric Tan

CIO & CSO at Flock Safety

“Fleet has some of the best API tooling we've used in a long time!”

Andy Gombar

Staff Incident Response Security Engineer

“Fleet is incredibly easy to deploy and perfect for lean IT teams. It's everything we need in a device management platform, simple, efficient, and powerful.”

Chayce O'Neal

Head of IT @ ConductorOne

“Fleet aligns with the strategies that enabled me to help scale Uber’s global device deployments with a lean DevOps/systems engineering team.”

Luis Madrigal

Engineering Leader, Uber

“The visibility down into the assets covered by the agent is phenomenal. Fleet has become the central source for a lot of things.” See the video.

Andre Shields

Staff Cybersecurity Engineer, Vulnerability Management

“We can build it exactly the way we want it. Which is just not possible on other platforms.” See the video.

Austin Anderson

Cybersecurity team senior manager

“It’s great to see the new release of Fleet containing some really cool new features that make osquery much more usable in practical environments. I’m really impressed with the work that Zach Wasserman and the crew are doing at Fleet.”

Mike Arpaia

Creator of osquery

“Osquery is one of the best tools out there and Fleet makes it even better. Highly recommend it if you want to monitor, detect and investigate threats on a scale and also for infra/sys admin. I have used it on 15k servers and it’s really scalable.”

Ahmed Elshaer

DFIR, Blue Teaming, SecOps

“Fleet has such a huge amount of use cases. My goal was to get telemetry on endpoints, but then our IR team, our TBM team, and multiple other folks in security started heavily utilizing the system in ways I didn’t expect. It spread so naturally, even our corporate and infrastructure teams want to run it.” See the video.

charles zaffery

Principle computer janitor

“I just want to brag again about how awesome Fleet and Snowflake are together. Osquery alone isn't a big data tool, but it's a powerful data collector.” See the video.

tom larkin

Sr. Manager, Client Engineering & DevOps

“Something I really appreciate about working with you guys is that it doesn't feel like I'm talking to a vendor. It actually feels like I'm talking to my team, and I really appreciate it.”

Chandra Majumdar

Partner - Cyber and Strategic Risk

“Fleet helped us determine that Norton antivirus (pre-installed on some machines) was interfering with Crowdstrike's ability to detect downloaded malware.”

Arsenio Figueroa

Senior Systems Security Engineer

“I recently attended a GitOps workshop hosted by the team at Fleet—and WOW, it was truly inspiring! Seeing industry-standard tools like osquery and git combined with MDM and CI/CD to manage endpoints was impressive. With support for Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS, iPadOS, and Chrome OS, managing everything from a single codebase is a game-changer. Super cool. I’ve been a fan of Fleet, and the GitOps functionality showcased at the workshop added yet another dimension to an already exciting product. If you’re in IT or device management/client platform engineering, I highly recommend checking out one of these sessions.”

Justin LaBo

Head of Core BT Engineering

“Thanks for a great run Jamf... Foursquare has officially completed the migration to Fleet as our new device management platform.”

Mike Meyer

Senior systems engineer & Technical lead

“My users love this. It's increasing security and compliance across our workforce.”

Bart Reardon

Creator of swiftDialog

“The ability to get heard [with our previous MDM] was just impossible.”

Wes Whetstone

Staff CPE at Stripe

“If I needed a single pane of glass for all OS endpoints, starting fresh, I'd push for the paid version of FleetDM.”

u/Heteronymous

Redditor

“We chose Fleet because they take Linux desktop management seriously. It was smooth as butter to set up and start deploying. Fleet gives me the peace of mind knowing that our Linux Fleet is properly managed, monitored, and secure.”

Roger Cantrell

IT Operations Engineer

“The customer support and care has been 'world class'. Even on the other side of the world.”

David Bodmer

IT Systems Engineer

“Fleet is the best multi-OS MDM on the market currently and is improving daily. Fleet makes sense for me because of their amazing support, transparent and detailed reporting, app updating functionality, self-service, and macOS DDM support.”

Fiona Skelton

Senior Technology Specialist

“Fleet enabled us to consolidate our patchwork of endpoint tools with a single platform, eliminating complexity and cutting licensing costs. The shift to GitOps has modernized our operations giving us the agility and change control we needed giving leadership real-time confidence in device health and compliance. The result is a more efficient, secure environment where IT can move faster on strategic projects instead of firefighting or maintaining multiple legacy systems.”

Dan Jackson

Sr Manager Systems Engineering

“Fleet made the process of migrating fast, easy, and simple. We're excited to work with a team that's aligned with us on open source, and has fantastic technical support. Compared to Kandji, it's a night and day improvement.”

John O'Nolan

Founder & CEO

“When Adobe released a patch for the recent Acrobat Reader zero day, I decided to take a look at Fleet's patch management capabilities, and I was surprised at just how quickly a patch policy could be created and deployed. I didn't have to create the query and I didn't have to source the package, since it was one of Fleet's maintained apps. Really great work on making this so effortless by the team at Fleet Device Management.”

Brian LaShomb

Senior Client Platform Engineer, Epic Games

“We moved our Mac MDM solution to Fleet. No complaints so far as a tenant. Very transparent and easy to use.”

Adam Pippert

Principal Solutions Architect @ Red Hat

“We use Fleet Device Management. Basically, osquery is the answer.”

Ed Merrett

Director, Security & TechOps @ Harmonic Security

“Fleet has been the easiest MDM I’ve worked with”

Josh Radcliffe

Information Technology Operations Supervisor

“We have been using GitOps for Okta and Fleet at Figma in IT (and for AWS in infra). Was a nice win to have AI agents the product security team built improve corp and cloud security too!”

Brad Girardeau

Product Security & IT, Figma

“I'm spending about 20 hours a week less on managing PCs than I was with Intune.”

Mason Peressini

IT Manager and CPE, Reed College

“Fleet truly can support macOS, Windows, and Linux. No one else does that well enough to consider using one platform for all three, in my opinion.”

Shayna Waldman

Sr IT Engineer

“Having Fleet on site was phenomenal! Their professionalism and commitment to ensuring our use cases were managed was some of the best customer partnership we've ever seen.”

Jonathan Keyes

Director of Project Management at Hawx

“Endpoints are where AI risk actually shows up. You can't govern what you can't see. You need to know which AI tools and packages are running on your devices, what people are feeding them, and whether you can trust them. Device visibility plus risk intelligence is how you get there.”

Viktor Filipsson

Senior IT System Engineer, Sonos
